title.narrative: WBG - Women, Business and the Law

description.narrative: The objective of the program is to provide advice and technical support to encourage governments to guarantee the full and equal participation of women in the economy. The program aims to achieve this goal by working with client governments in the design of gender-neutral laws in line with the market failures described above, as well as on their implementation and dissemination. The program focus on (select) countries in Sub-Sahara Africa,
